messages:
dara (CS): Quick heads-up — Vega launches tomorrow. Account is 'watch'. Can someone whip up a tiny, customer-facing 1-page playbook for the first 48h: short prefill/warmup checklist, batching guidance by prompt size, streaming sanity checks, a 3-line smoke test, and a 2-question feedback ping? Need it customer-friendly and paste-ready.
lucas (CS): I can author. Plan: 4 bullets for customers, one "engineer note" with curl + thresholds, and a checkbox they can send back. Will keep language non-technical.
eva (eng-runtime): I'll provide the smoke test and expected numbers. Minimal recommended sequence: 1) run 10 warmup calls to prime KV/tokenizer caches; 2) run 25 streamed requests spaced ~150ms; 3) confirm first chunk <1.5s and KV hit rate >80%. If KV hit rate stays low after 10, bump to 30.
sam-support: Escalation guidance: If error rate >1.5% over 5m OR median generation latency >2s -> open urgent ticket. Include trace_id + 3 sample prompts. Feedback webhook will auto-create a ticket.
dara (CS): For customers I'll add a 3-item checklist they can copy into a support message to confirm they've done the steps. Also include the two feedback questions: Q1 "Did outputs meet expectations?" (Yes/No). Q2 "If no, short note." Hook to webhook.
eva (eng-runtime): Shareable curl (engineer note):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"warmup","stream":true,"batch_size":8}'
```
Quick checks to include: 200 OK, first stream chunk <=1500ms, KV hit rate climbs >80% after warmups. If streaming chunks are delayed, try non-stream endpoint and grab trace_id.
lucas (CS): Customer copy (very short): 
- Run prefill script (10 requests). 
- Apply batching: short prompts (<128 tokens) -> batch 32; medium (~128-512) -> 8-16; long (>512) -> 4-8. 
- Run smoke test and report results + feedback form.
dara (CS): I'll assemble the one-pager PDF + plain-text run commands and post to #customer-success and DM the Vega CSM by morning. Include an "if this happens" mini-triage table:
- symptom: "no stream chunks" -> action: check key/network; run curl; switch to non-stream and send trace_id.
- symptom: "low KV hits" -> action: increase prefill_count to 30 or request TTL increase.
- symptom: "high latency" -> action: reduce batch size, check prompt lengths, verify region.
ops-bot: Reminder: Vega dedicated warmup scheduled tonight 01:15 UTC.
sam-support: We'll tag any incoming webhook tickets with onboard/vega and notify the CSM channel.
dara (CS): Thanks team — this should be short enough for customers and precise enough for eng/support. Posting shortly :thumbsup:
